messages:
infra-bot: AUTOSCALER_ALERT at 1763001234 - gpu-autoscaler failed to increase pool count in eu-west-1. pool_util=0.92, queue_depth=4.2k, avg_queue_latency=12.3s. reason=scale_limit_hit(max_pools=10). paging @alice
ops-pager: Pager sent to alice (on-call). severity=sev2. links: https://metrics.redwood.io/d/queue/eu-west-1?from=now-1h
alice: got it, joining. quick ask — are customers seeing 5xxs or just throttles?
leah: most traffic is 429/requests-queued, some internal retry bursts. no widespread 5xxes yet.
mike: tagging +1, I'm near laptop. can we confirm autoscaler logs?
jia: pulling autoscaler logs now. looks like repeated ScaleUpRejected due to provider quota errors and a separate guardrail: "cluster max-pools reached".
leah: recorded examples: `ScaleUpRejected: insufficient quota (GPUs)`, `EvictionDelay: true` in controller logs.
rohan: customer monitoring showing elevated tail latency for enterprise customers in eu-west-1 for last 18m. CS notified a few customers.
tess: standing up a short customer comms draft. want to know ETA for mitigation first.
alice: immediate mitigation plan: 1) open temporary burst fallback to smaller-instance pool (quantized models) in eu-west-1, 2) enable cross-region routing to fallback pools in us-west-2 for non-data-resident traffic, 3) abort any in-progress large rollout that could be consuming capacity. who can run the fallbacks?
mike: I can flip the fallback routing for non-sensitive tenants. prepping a small pool in eu-west-1 with g4dn-small (quantized) via infra runbook. will need 10-12 min to warm up.
jia: I'm going to attempt a manual scale-up request to provider for +4 GPUs, but likely will take vendor approval ~20-30m.
leah: aborting current rollout now: `deployctl abort deploy/rl-model-v2 -n prod --reason "emergency capacity"` (exec in 2s)
ops-pager: bridge created: https://meet.redwood.io/bridge/1763001234-ops (join: @alice @mike @jia @leah)
alice: mike, start fallback in 2. leah, confirm aborted rollout. jia, vendor request status?
mike: starting fallback: applying Terraform snippet to create small-quantized pool. snippet:
```
resource "gpu_pool" "burst-quant" {
  region = "eu-west-1"
  instance_type = "g4dn.xlarge"
  count = 4
  model_variant = "quant-8bit"
}
```
apply in progress. logs: `creating 4 instances`
leah: confirmed abort returned 200, rollout stopped, traffic draining off new model instances.
jia: vendor request submitted (ticket #VEND-9921). provider acknowledged, ETA 28m for approval. also seeing provider rate-limits on API calls (429 on create requests).
alice: ok continue fallback and cross-region routing. mike, after pool is ready, please enable prefix routing for the high-volume prefix `/v1/generate` to fallback pool with lower qps per-connection. add strict rate-limiter so we don't OOM smaller instances.
mike: got it. implementing routing change: `route-apply --match-path /v1/generate --target gpu_pool.burst-quant --weight 0.2` - will ramp to 20% traffic first.
rohan: CS needs a short blurb for affected customers: "We are seeing elevated request queues in eu-west-1. Traffic is being routed to fallback capacity; you may see increased latency for some requests. We will follow up with timeline."
tess: drafting and will share in channel before sending.
ops-pager: automation note: auto-fallback policy triggered earlier but blocked by guardrail "no-quantized-deploy-in-prod" flag. flag overridden by oncall due to severity.
jia: small pool is READY (4 instances). running smoke tests now.
mike: smoke looks ok, enabling 20% route now. traffic shifting. queue depth dropping from 4.2k -> 1.1k in 6m. avg_latency down to 6.8s. :thumbsup:
alice: excellent. keep ramping cautiously. jia continue vendor chase for permanent quota. leah monitor eviction events; ensure KV caches not thrashing.
leah: seeing a few eviction logs - adjusting cache TTL for fallback pools to 5m to reduce memory pressure.
rohan: CS update ready after you confirm latency stabilizes for 15m.
ops-pager: escalated to infra-leads for postmortem and action items.
mike: increasing fallback weight to 40% now. queue at 420 -> 260 in 4m.
jia: vendor ticket updated: provider promised quota add but needs formal PO, procurement loop ~3-4 business days. short-term we need either more small instances or cross-region permanent shift.
leah: quick note: root cause summary so far - autoscaler hit configured max_pools; provider quota prevented additional large instance creation; guardrail prevented automatic fallback to quantized pool until manual override.
alice: agreed. immediate mitigation success. next steps: 1) short postmortem draft, 2) adjust guardrail to allow auto-fallback for sev2+, 3) increase max_pools in eu-west-1 from 10->14 with gradual ramp, 4) procurement/ops to secure quota increase for on-call usage. assign owners?
jia: I'll own vendor/quota (#1 vendor).
mike: I'll own fallback automation changes (#2) and add a canary test.
leah: I'll own observability/alerts (#3) and make eviction alerts more actionable.
alice: I'll own postmortem and follow-up with product and CS for customer comms (#4).
tess: noted — will coordinate the customer comms and the release notes.
rohan: CS will track impacted customers and update any open tickets.
alice: final wrap: system stabilized at 1763001620. leaving thread open for postmortem edits. quick checklist to turn into formal postmortem: 
- timeline of queue growth and mitigations (data from metrics)
- exact autoscaler errors (logs)
- guardrail evaluation and why it blocked auto-fallback
- customer impact list and comms timeline
- action items with owners and due dates

Action items (from thread):
- jia: secure vendor quota / submit procurement path (due 2026-03-22)
- mike: make auto-fallback opt-in for severe incidents and add canary (due 2026-03-18)
- leah: tune eviction alerts and TTL defaults for fallback pools (due 2026-03-16)
- alice: draft postmortem and coordinate cross-team review (due 2026-03-17)
- tess/rohan: finalize customer comms and notify affected customers (due 2026-03-15)

Thanks all, closing live bridge. :white_check_mark:
